---
name: Propose an advisory check
about: Suggest a vendor bulletin that administrators can assess using deployment records.
title: ""
---

## Advisory and product

Give the CVE or vendor ID, affected product or package, publication date, and the original maintainer or distribution link.

## Evidence an administrator can supply

Describe the deployed version, package origin, or configuration record needed to answer the question. Use synthetic examples and omit client details.

## Expected decisions

List an affected release and the first fixed release for each relevant branch. Identify at least one input that must remain unknown, such as a distribution build without a backport decision.

## Coverage

Name an existing skill that could cover this advisory. If the check requires different evidence, describe that difference.
